verdict.rationale: Green & Spiegel's materials cover both nonimmigrant visas and green-card routes, with attached summaries of the most common employment-based visa types and permanent-residency paths. It also has a dedicated start-ups practice and a university-incubator (J-1/student entrepreneur) founder pathway. However, none of the cited materials name O-1, H-1B, cap-exempt H-1B, E-2 or TN, and choosing the right visa is deferred to a consultation ('contact us to discuss the various options') rather than written guidance. Missing for 10: explicit coverage of O-1, H-1B including cap-exempt routes, E-2 and TN, plus self-serve guidance on choosing a visa.
